title: Berrry Computer joins the Vibe Coding list
summary:
A community project joins the Vibe Coding list: tweet an app idea, get a little web app.

The project list now includes @vgrichina’s Berrry Computer. Reply to a tweet with an app idea and mention @BerrryComputer to get a small web app on its own subdomain; the generated apps use pollinations.ai for dynamic AI experiences.
